نسترئي (form X)
# نَسْتَرْئِي (nastarʔī) /nas.tar.ʔiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْأَى (istarʔā)
# نَسْتَرْئِيَ (nastarʔiya) /nas.tar.ʔi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَى (istarʔā)
